title: Coral and the Bakery
author: L. M. Winterbourne
blurb: Theo Quintana, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the festival ends.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
